thread:
sara p: Got a surprise invoice for a mail-away genetic panel. Carrier marked it OON even though vendor site says "in-network". Anyone seen this?

 tom k: Which plan? Did you check member portal for the claim reason code?

 sara p: I'm on Plus. Claim shows reason: provider not contracted. But lab account shows contract number on their portal.

 lina (benefits): Hi Sara 3 common mismatch: performing billing entity vs ordering lab. Can you DM the claim # and last 4 of your member ID? Don't post PHI here.

 people-ops-bot: Upload docs: https://benefits.redwood-inc/claims-upload. Carrier lab line: 1-800-555-1212.

 sara p: DM'd claim 2025-44988 and 1234. Uploaded invoice + kit tracking.

 lina (benefits): Thanks. We'll open intake ticket and verify network status for the billing NPI. If needed we'll file appeal and request prior auth retrospectively.

 tom k: If carrier insists OON, what's timing to get reimbursed?

 lina (benefits): Appeal first. If appeal denied, submit OON reimbursement via portal. Typical processing 7-14 business days after full docs. We'll update this thread.

 sara p: Appreciate it. Please escalate if carrier slow.

 people-ops-bot: Intake ticket #BP-2025-804 created. Carrier outreach started. ETA 3 business days for response.
